'''''Brigada en acción''''' is a [[1977 in film|1977]]  [[Argentina|Argentine]] [[comedy film]] directed by and starring [[Palito Ortega]] and written by [[Juan Carlos Mesa]]. The film premiered in Argentina on 21 July  1977.
